Lythraceae.key_door: persistent perigynous floral tube/hypanthium + usually superior ovary + many-seeded capsule; Ammannia vs Rotala by auriculate vs tapered leaf base

Myrtaceae.key_door: woody + opposite simple gland-dotted leaves + intramarginal vein + many stamens + inferior ovary + fleshy berry

anchor_families.Onagraceae: inferior ovary + hypanthium/floral tube, usually 4-part flowers in project Oenothera

taxonomy_notes: Ammannia coccinea, A. auriculata, Lythrum alatum, L. californicum and Rotala ramosior remain accepted current species concepts.
Current Kew accepts Feijoa sellowiana and treats Acca sellowiana as a synonym.
Feijoa sellowiana is South American in origin and is a nonlocal cultivated comparison in this learner.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not identify Lythraceae by petal color or leaf arrangement alone.
Do not require aroma/crushing for Myrtaceae identification; use visible glands, venation and flowers.
Do not present Feijoa sellowiana as a Central Texas native.
